title: Book Two · Chapter 75: Under the Same Tree
story:
During the summer holiday, Ronan, Leo and Jun meet under a tree near the little square. Ronan is ten now. His shoes feel tight at the toes, but he can still run in them.

Jun stands at the edge of the tree's shadow.

“It reaches here,” he says.

Leo puts a small stone beside Jun's shoe. Ronan finds a second stone and puts it near the end of his own shadow.

“Mine is longer.”

“You are standing in a different place,” Leo says.

They choose one mark on the ground. Each boy stands there in turn. Jun's shadow seems longest, but his foot is not quite on the mark.

Ronan moves it back with his shoe. Jun loses his balance and grabs Ronan's arm. Both boys step away from the place.

“Now nobody wins,” Leo says.

They try again. Each boy stays clear of the others. The three shadows are almost the same length. Ronan is sure his own is a little longer than Leo's.

“Ask Mei,” Jun says.

“She is not here.”

“Then the tree can decide.”

They look up at the leaves. A breeze moves the leaves. The edge of the tree's shadow shakes over their stones.

Ronan sits down. The ground is warm under his hands. He likes this place. Behind them, he can hear the street. Ahead, he can see the open square. He does not want to argue about his feet all afternoon.

Leo has a small puzzle from a book. He describes it. He keeps the answer to himself. Three cups are on a table. A bean is under one cup. Jun chooses the left cup. Ronan chooses the middle. Leo says they need real cups.

They make three little paper covers instead. Jun puts a stone under one and moves the covers. Ronan watches closely, but chooses the wrong one. Leo chooses the right one. He lifts his hands. “I win!”

An hour later, they go back to their shadow marks. The edge of the tree's shade is past the first stone. Their own shadows point a different way.

Leo moves the stone. Ronan stops him.

“Leave the first one. Put another there.”

Now they can see both places at once. Jun puts a third stone beside their feet.

At home, Ronan tells Mum about the tree's shadow. “The tree stays still, but its shadow moves,” he says. She looks out of the window at their own little patch of shade.

“Will it come in and wash the bowls?”

“Not today,” he says. He takes two bowls to the kitchen himself.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

tree＝树；shadow＝影子；stone＝石头。

## 理解问题

1. 三个孩子怎样发现影子会改变？
2. Ronan为什么没有继续争输赢？

## 读句子

**Leo / moves / the stone.** Leo／挪动／那块石头。
